name: curie-manager
description: Example bundle: an agent that manages the Curie install it runs on. Through one connector that holds the platform key, it reads agents, deployments, schedules, budgets, approvals, traces and metrics, and runs routine operations without asking: fire a hook, pause or resume a schedule, kill or resume an agent, set a budget, add memory, redeploy an existing version. Every delete waits for a human approval. A weekday check posts the platform's health to its channel.

triggers.name: platform-check
triggers.prompt: [scheduled: platform-check] Check the platform and post its health.
